title: 공명 측정자 — anima-side bench of UNIVERSE H_345/346 capstone

substrate.rule_selection_rationale: span Wolfram classes I-IV (broader than H_345/346's {110, 30, 105, 150})

verdict_text: primary r=-0.31 — sign-reversed and below |0.5| threshold; H_345/346 finding does NOT survive 4-rule -> 8-rule broadening on the anima-side n=4 bench
honest_caveats: rule=90 (additive XOR) is a strong outlier: max_basin=16 but mean_Phi=0.0 — additive TPM produces flat phi_structure regardless of basin concentration
rule=60 vs rule=90 both have max_basin=16 but Phi=14.125 vs 0.0 — basin alone is not predictive when the TPM is additive
n=4 has only 16 states (vs n=5 32 states), reducing per-rule Phi resolution; this is a separate axis from rule-set breadth
8 rules with df=6 is small; t-stat |0.81| is not significant (two-sided p > 0.4 at df=6)
H_345/346 use n=5 + curated 4 rules; this bench uses n=4 + broader 8 rules — finding is the joint effect of (a) rule-set breadth and (b) n=4 vs n=5
interpretation: H_346 capstone's basin↔Φ coupling (+0.550 / −0.951) appears to be RULE-SET FRAGILE rather than purely robust. The 4 rules curated for H_345 ({110, 30, 105, 150}) happen to align basin and Φ; broadening to 8 rules spanning Wolfram classes I-IV introduces XOR-additive rules (90) and intermediate-class rules (54, 126, 184) that decouple basin from Φ. The aux signal (n_attr↔Φ = +0.12) goes from H_346's strong −0.95 to near-zero — the more decisive collapse.
anti_tautology: basin and Phi are independently computed (basin from dynamics, Phi from TPM structure)
Pearson is computed on the actual 8 measurements without any rule-set tuning post-hoc
pre-registered verdict thresholds (|r| 0.5 / 0.2) are honored even though the result is reversed
rule selection committed BEFORE measurement (rules = [45,54,60,90,110,126,150,184] in source)
follow_ups: bench n=5 with the same 8-rule set to isolate the n axis (currently confounded with rule-set breadth)
bench at n=4 with the H_345 4 rules {110, 30, 105, 150} to confirm rule-set is the dominant axis
investigate additive-rule (XOR families: 60, 90, 105, 150) Phi structure — flat for 90 but not for 60/105/150
